t: Lemonilo Makes Indonesia Healthy Again
s: April 11, 2022 - We asked around and found that the biggest challenge in achieving healthy lifestyle is food: how to have healthy food that tastes good and is affordable,” Lemonilo Co-Founder Johannes Ardiant says. “Indonesian food is mostly filled with coconut milk, oil, sugar, and other high-cholesterol ingredients, in addition to preservatives and additives. We want to solve this by making it easier for people to buy and discover healthier alternatives to their daily food, that’s how we came up with Lemonilo.”
